prose: ldraw-nova is an open-source tool where an AI agent turns a model idea into an LDraw LEGO model. The user guides the agent while it builds, and its part and example lookups use jev-rerank, the author's semantic search with re-ranking backed by TypeSafe's Jev model.
It runs as a Dockerised web app and needs two sibling repos at the same tag and about 5 GB of disk for the first build.
highlights: Agent builds LEGO models in LDraw format from an idea.
Part search uses jev-rerank, built on TypeSafe's Jev.
Runs in Docker; needs two repos at v0.6.0 and about 5 GB.
Show HN project by the same author.
